title: Appam
description: Lacy, soft-centred Kerala rice and coconut pancakes with crisp edges, fermented overnight and served with stew or kurma.
steps: Drain the soaked rice and grind with the coconut and a little of the water to a smooth batter.
Stir the yeast and sugar with a spoon of warm water and let it froth for 5 minutes.
Mix the yeast into the batter with the salt, cover and ferment 6 to 8 hours until bubbly.
Thin the batter with water to a pouring consistency of single cream.
Heat an appam pan and wipe it with a little coconut oil.
Pour a ladle of batter, swirl the pan to coat the sides, cover and cook 2 minutes until the edges are crisp and the centre is spongy.
